draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 84th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 10th of 27 at CB. He lasted until pick 157, well after his grade rank (84th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Taron Johnson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2025) ranked 1st in passes defended among the 27 CBs in his class with stats.
